info.name: Marine Pollution - Security Testing
info.description: Postman collection for SE4030 Secure Software Development security testing and baseline verification against the Marine Pollution Management local application.

request.description: Baseline registration of a standard volunteer account.
Baseline login returning JWT token.
Protected profile endpoint requiring valid Bearer token.
Fetch all cleanup tasks.
Create a new cleanup task. Copy returned `_id` into `{{taskId}}`.
Update existing task.
Delete existing task by ID.
Get volunteer list.
Create volunteer profile. Copy returned `_id` into `{{volunteerId}}`.
Update volunteer profile.
Delete volunteer profile.

VULNERABILITY TEST 1.1:
Missing authentication and role check on cleanup task deletion.
Expected Vulnerable Result: 200 OK with `{"message": "Task deleted successfully"}` without supplying any Authorization token.
Expected Secure Result: 401 Unauthorized.

VULNERABILITY TEST 1.2:
Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) on volunteer profile update without ownership verification.
Expected Vulnerable Result: 200 OK returning the tampered volunteer document.
Expected Secure Result: 401 Unauthorized or 403 Forbidden.

VULNERABILITY TEST 1.3:
Vertical privilege escalation by requesting `Cleanup_Task_Manager` role during open registration without authorization key.
Expected Vulnerable Result: 201 Created with role `Cleanup_Task_Manager`.
Expected Secure Result: 400 Bad Request or role defaulted to `volunteer`.

VULNERABILITY TEST 2.1:
Trivial password acceptance (only checks length >= 6, no complexity requirement for numbers, symbols, uppercase).
Expected Vulnerable Result: 201 Created with `123456`.
Expected Secure Result: 400 Bad Request with password complexity requirements.

VULNERABILITY TEST 2.2a:
Hardcoded default administrator credentials created by backend seeder on every startup.
Expected Vulnerable Result: 200 OK logging in as Default Admin with `role: admin`.
Expected Secure Result: Seeder removed or enforced one-time dynamic initial password prompt.

VULNERABILITY TEST 2.2b:
Hardcoded default manager credentials created by backend seeder on every startup.
Expected Vulnerable Result: 200 OK logging in as Cleanup Task Manager with `role: Cleanup_Task_Manager`.
Expected Secure Result: Seeder removed.

item.name: AUTH-04: Lack of Login Rate Limiting (BEFORE-FIX)

request.description:
VULNERABILITY TEST 2.3:
Absence of rate limiting on login endpoint allowing brute-force dictionary attacks.
Expected Vulnerable Result: Repeated rapid requests continuously return 401 without HTTP 429 Too Many Requests blocking.
Expected Secure Result: 429 Too Many Requests after 5-10 failed attempts.

item.name: DATA-01: Public Exposure of Volunteer PII (BEFORE-FIX)

request.description:
VULNERABILITY TEST 3.1:
Public unrestricted exposure of Volunteer PII (phone number, full name, address/city, schedule).
Expected Vulnerable Result: 200 OK returning all volunteer personal details without requiring authentication.
Expected Secure Result: 401 Unauthorized (requiring admin/authenticated authorization).

item.name: DATA-02: Forged JWT Using Hardcoded Fallback Secret (BEFORE-FIX)

request.description:
VULNERABILITY TEST 3.2:
Using a forged JWT signed with the codebase's hardcoded fallback secret 'your-secret-key' to access protected admin endpoint.
Expected Vulnerable Result: 200 OK accepting the forged admin token when JWT_SECRET is not set in production.
Expected Secure Result: Server rejects application boot if JWT_SECRET is missing or weak.

item.name: XSS-01: Stored XSS via Task Payload Injection (BEFORE-FIX)

request.description:
VULNERABILITY TEST 4.1:
Injecting unescaped HTML/JavaScript tags into stored database fields.
Expected Vulnerable Result: 201 Created storing raw HTML tags verbatim into MongoDB.
Expected Secure Result: Input sanitized with DOMPurify / sanitize-html or schema validation rejecting HTML tags.

item.name: XSS-02: Missing Security Headers on Static Uploads (BEFORE-FIX)

request.description:
VULNERABILITY TEST 4.2:
Verifying that static express file server lacks Content-Disposition: attachment and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff headers.
Expected Vulnerable Result: Headers tab lacks X-Content-Type-Options and Content-Security-Policy.
Expected Secure Result: Helmet and Content-Disposition enforced on uploaded assets.

item.name: NOSQL-01: NoSQL Object Injection in Auth Query (BEFORE-FIX)

request.description:
VULNERABILITY TEST 5.1:
Submitting a MongoDB operator object `{"$ne": null}` in place of a string for the email field.
Expected Vulnerable Result: 200 OK logging into the first active user matched in the collection (or executing the operator query without type error).
Expected Secure Result: 400 Bad Request (Email must be a string).

item.name: NOSQL-02: Query Parameter Operator Injection in Filtering (BEFORE-FIX)

request.description:
VULNERABILITY TEST 5.2:
Passing nested query parameters `?status[$ne]=Completed` spread directly into Mongoose `Task.find()`.
Expected Vulnerable Result: 200 OK returning all tasks where status is NOT 'Completed' via raw MongoDB operator execution.
Expected Secure Result: Query parameters validated against strict string allowlist or sanitized with express-mongo-sanitize.

item.name: NOSQL-03: Mass Assignment in Volunteer Creation (BEFORE-FIX)

request.description:
VULNERABILITY TEST 5.3:
Passing arbitrary unvalidated fields directly into `new Volunteer(req.body)`.
Expected Vulnerable Result: 201 Created accepting arbitrary request body without DTO/Zod validation schema.
Expected Secure Result: 400 Bad Request with strict validation schema.

VULNERABILITY TEST 6.1:
Testing overly permissive CORS policy that accepts ANY origin ending with `.vercel.app` with `Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true`.
Expected Vulnerable Result: Response headers include `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://malicious-phishing-site.vercel.app` and `Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true`.
Expected Secure Result: CORS rejects unknown origins.

VULNERABILITY TEST 6.2:
Public exposure of full API Swagger UI documentation exposing all schemas and private endpoints.
Expected Vulnerable Result: 200 OK returning HTML Swagger documentation.
Expected Secure Result: Disabled in production or protected by basic auth/VPN.

item.name: MISCONFIG-03: Missing HTTP Security Headers / No Helmet (BEFORE-FIX)

request.description:
VULNERABILITY TEST 6.3:
Absence of standard security headers (X-Frame-Options, CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options).
Expected Vulnerable Result: Response Headers tab lacks Helmet headers (X-Frame-Options, Content-Security-Policy).
Expected Secure Result: Full suite of HTTP security headers present.
